```cypher
MATCH (p_courserating:Plugin {component: 'tool_courserating'})
WITH p_courserating.louvain_soc AS courserating_community
MATCH (p:Plugin)
WHERE p.louvain_soc = courserating_community
WITH p
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MAINTAINS]->(m:Maintainer)
WITH p, COUNT(m) AS num_maintainers
WHERE num_maintainers = 1
  AND (p.last_release_ts IS NULL OR p.last_release_ts < (apoc.date.parse('2026-09-10', 'yyyy-MM-dd').epochMillis / 1000) - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60))
RETURN p.component, p.name, num_maintainers AS maintainer_count, datetime({epochSeconds: p.last_release_ts}) AS last_release_date
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT 100
```
